title: Watermark Evidence under Open-Weight LLM Modification: Exact Bounds for Low-Rank Output Watermarks
abstract: arXiv:2611.21702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight language models can continue generating after their released weights are modified, while a watermark verifier still scores outputs against the original base and marked models. We study how such modifications change the evidence available to an OpenStamp-style verifier. At each shared prefix, we represent the modification as a residual in the next-token logits. We derive an exact finite-vocabulary lower bound on the expected log-likelihood-ratio evidence under a residual-span constraint, along with a sharp span-only deviation bound. We also characterize the first-order evidence shift through a covariance term with an explicit second-order remainder, and determine the residual span needed to reach a target evidence level. For sequence-level detection, we derive an exact conditional exponential-moment bound and combine it with a supermartingale argument and a distribution-free order-statistic tolerance bound. translated_title: 开放权重大语言模型修改下的水印证据：低秩输出水印的精确界
translated_abstract: 开放权重语言模型在其发布的权重被修改后仍可继续生成文本，而水印验证器仍会依据原始基础模型与带水印模型对输出进行评分。我们研究此类修改如何改变 OpenStamp 式验证器可获得的证据。在每个共享前缀处，我们将修改表示为下一词元 logits 中的残差。我们推导出残差跨度约束下期望对数似然比证据的精确有限词表下界，以及一个仅依赖跨度的锐利偏差界。我们还通过一个带有显式二阶余项的协方差项刻画了一阶证据偏移，并确定了达到目标证据水平所需的残差跨度。对于序列级检测，我们推导出精确的条件指数矩界，并将其与超鞅论证和无分布假设的次序统计容许界相结合，从而得到了一种高性能的（摘要在此处被截断）检测方法。
tldr: 该论文针对开放权重大语言模型权重被修改后水印验证失效的问题，推导出残差约束下水印证据的精确有限词表下界以及序列级检测的严格统计界，证明 OpenStamp 式验证器在模型被修改的情况下依然可靠。
